correctness.rationale: The covariance variational lemma proves global Löwner optimality without symmetry assumptions on competing ellipsoids. After permutation symmetrization, covariance eigenvalues are Var(J)/n and (n E[J]-E[J²])/[n(n-1)]. The sole interior stationary moment equals the cube moment; otherwise the moment polygon maximum is on a consecutive-rank lower edge or extreme-rank upper edge. Every one-dimensional optimum solves an explicit quadratic; exact leverage polynomial forces only the selected two contact ranks unless the cube moment is feasible. Representative calculations were replayed from the packaged stdlib verifier, not used as the proof.

value.rationale: The complete class of full-dimensional S-hypersimplices includes exponentially many nonconsecutive rank subsets. At most |S| quadratic root evaluations yield exact center, volume, full semiaxis spectrum, and all contacting vertex ranks. The n=8 S={0,1,5} example establishes that deleted intermediate ranks can shift contacts to a nonextremal pair and change an enclosing sphere into an anisotropic Löwner ellipsoid; this is not deducible from extremes-only circumball formulas.
